profile.summary: A public agency that serves the 31 school districts of Santa Clara County, California. It provides instructional, business and technology services to districts, and directly runs some educational programs such as special education, alternative schools and preschool. It also oversees districts' academic and fiscal health and county-authorized charter schools.
